## Scope

Implements #273 on the isolated `codex/issue273-active-head` branch from #271. The PR remains draft while the preregistered public evaluation is open. No merge or issue closure is requested.

## Checkpoints

- [x] 0 — prospective v1 format, quota/refund, physical bounds and public case/cache contract (`d9f8ef615`, with amendments in history)
- [x] 1 — Workspace-scoped pack, pooled typed index, final extents, pins and external ext4 backing proof (`1cefa6043`, `b8d1f1a50`)
- [x] 2 — one LocalEdit active view for content, namespace, attributes, dirty membership and pinned reads; mutable legacy-root writers retired (`b68c968e3`)
- [x] 3 — atomic active tuple capture, final-view SaveFile/C1 lowering, C5 Stage/Commit and successor reconciliation (`a4c54e62b`); [checkpoint-3 receipts](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/da2c96ee9/core/docs/issues/273/CHECKPOINT3-LOG.md)
- [x] 4 — mixed-page compaction, pin-aware exact refunds and public many-file/multi-generation lifetime proof (`38bcf9912`, reviewed product fix `05fca30fb`, external count oracle `6f8c5a684`); [checkpoint-4 log](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/79eca5ddd1b8d6eb1f84a53f5e2486a83bac0d27/core/docs/issues/273/CHECKPOINT4-LOG.md)
- [x] 4.5 proposal — three-subagent source/research audit, implementation spec and Workspace incremental/process-continuity rules (`941613f65`); [spec](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/941613f65f4bbf78c3af8cdd60b1a27118d46e00/core/docs/issues/273/PHASE4.5-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC.md), [audit](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/941613f65f4bbf78c3af8cdd60b1a27118d46e00/core/docs/issues/273/PHASE4.5-RESEARCH-AUDIT.md)
- [ ] 4.5 implementation/proof — selected v2 hot path, charged cache/candidate admission, carries/retirement and continued-process/post-Commit proofs
- [ ] 5 — frozen-source 3 × 3 public evaluation, separate quick-Commit controls and unchanged #248 gate; [ready-to-use handoff](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/941613f65f4bbf78c3af8cdd60b1a27118d46e00/core/docs/issues/273/HANDOFF-CHECKPOINT5.md)

## Phase 4.5 proposal and owner sequencing

The new [implementation specification](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/941613f65f4bbf78c3af8cdd60b1a27118d46e00/core/docs/issues/273/PHASE4.5-IMPLEMENTATION-SPEC.md) defines expected files, ASCII architecture/component/publication/G1-G2 diagrams, private v2 HotRef/fixed-fence/selected-directory format, cache/candidate bounds, control/current/target complexity and external proof gates. Three subagents audited source, architecture and resources; their concrete safety/amortization corrections are in the [research audit](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/941613f65f4bbf78c3af8cdd60b1a27118d46e00/core/docs/issues/273/PHASE4.5-RESEARCH-AUDIT.md). This is prospective documentation; no v2 implementation or performance result is claimed.

Scope is hot WRITE; concurrent Exec admission remains outside this phase. Structural eligible publication targets amortized O(1) operations; physical custody retains O(log A), resident lookup O(log V), growing charged owner state and current O(E_f) per-file Commit scratch. The latter is explicitly a Workspace upload scratch scaling regression from the control's bounded cursor/window, with full streaming deferred. Cumulative reconcile/cloning must be precharged before implementation can claim bounded admission.

[Repository AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/blob/941613f65f4bbf78c3af8cdd60b1a27118d46e00/AGENTS.md#workspace-private-backing-and-running-processes) now requires incremental private backing both before and after Commit and active processes/held handles/G2 edits continuing without suspension, Exec drain, remount, reset or full-Workspace rebuild. Commit/eviction normalizes only affected hot closure. Continued hot writes after saved-base installation and an unrelated surviving cursor are proof gates.

**Owner merge order: fully complete side lane #273, including phase 4.5 and checkpoint 5, before the main lane merges.** #264/PR #269 owns mounted namespace/charged ancestry and adjacent resource changes; integrate later with affected combined proofs. Its integration is not a prerequisite for this lane. Do not reintroduce 256-node/128-dirty caps or label currently posted #264 receipts as broader resource proof. Checkpoint 5 stays NOT_RUN until this lane completes phase 4.5 implementation/proof and freezes its source.

Docs/policy verification: 47 local links/anchors, code fences, resource arithmetic, staged whitespace check; boundary guard passed (342 files), all nine guard self-tests passed. No Cargo build/test/examples/clippy/fmt or performance sample ran for this docs-only change; existing checkpoint-4 C1 failures retain their qualification.

## Checkpoint 4 proof and limits

Final product source is `05fca30fb46a616a6988a60d3532f4255c9b3cf8`. Active reconciliation removes final G1 extent/inverse references in one index publication; pack and large Payload owners retain charge until every selecting capture/read pin ends. Mixed sealed pages relocate their live slots, inverse references and locator atomically. Ordinary mutations relocate at most one touched source page; Commit pools remaining pages. Review fixed a quota-pressure path that could copy one partly dead page without a block refund. The external backing oracle now proves 68 slots moved, 68 inverse references changed, one new pack-page write and 4,096 actual pack bytes refunded at 122,880 B remaining; a lone partially dead page is skipped.

At clean product source, **13/13 locked-release native Service selections passed on Linux ext4**, including mounted FUSE write/append → unmount → Commit, G1/G2 capture, 128 one-byte files, 4,097 repeated overwrites, 32 retained generations, mutation/Commit compaction, large `p-*` refund, split slots, public quota refusal, postpublication cleanup failure and full 8,194-byte oracle for 4,096 separated writes. Release `active_backing` passed **25/25**. The 4,096-write space checkpoint observed **1,224,704 B before Commit** (52 pack pages) and **24,576 B afterward** (zero pack pages), with actual private `st_blocks * 512` equal to Host charge and zero blocks after clean close. Failed/uncertain cleanup deliberately keeps charge and refuses close. [All receipts, including ten failed development diagnostics, are retained](https://github.com/Ephemeral-AI-Lab/layerfs/tree/79eca5ddd1b8d6eb1f84a53f5e2486a83bac0d27/core/docs/issues/273/evidence/checkpoint4).

These are **functional and count/space proofs**, with `cache_claim=null`. The 4,096-write complete functional command took 16.306 s and is not the #248 4,097-write gate. The combined clean/one-edit functional diagnostic took 15.448 s including preparation and cleanup; it cannot replace the two separately registered 15 s controls. No latency PASS, candidate speed number, cache-qualified 2× claim or release admission exists.

## Checks and remaining gates

Locked release Core workspace Clippy, Core examples, fmt, product boundary (342 source files), its nine self-tests, targeted Core Workspace tests, release Linux backing and the named public cases passed. The full locked Core test command still **fails** in two unchanged `layerfs-content` `filesystem_ordering` cases: `a_fresh_build_charges_its_count_array_to_the_ordering_ceiling` and `a_high_pending_ceiling_runs_spill_free_to_the_byte_bound` (19 objects against limit 18). No C1/C2 source changed. This repository has no CI or aggregate preflight gate; neither is claimed green.

Checkpoint 5 remains **NOT_RUN**: the nine 10 MiB cases in both arms, separate clean/one-edit Commit controls, unchanged #248 selection, matched enforced cold cache, full independent old/new-head verifier and remaining named aggregate correctness cells. Historical #248 FAIL and #271 cache-INELIGIBLE receipts retain their original status. Keep this PR draft and issue #273 open.
